title: Surface 5 Modernization: Complete 24-Module Admin Console, In-App Blog Editor, Maintenance Controller & AI Provider Orchestration
spec:
# IME365 DIR-006 — SURFACE 5 MASTER ENGINEERING DIRECTIVE
## Surface 5 Modernization: Complete 24-Module Admin Console, In-App Blog Editor, Maintenance Controller & AI Provider Orchestration

**Directive ID:** DIR-006  
**Priority:** P0 — Critical  
**Surface:** Surface 5 of 5 (Admin Console & Complete Platform Operations)  
**Depends On:** DIR-005 (Unlocks automatically when DIR-005 is certified & frozen)  
**Executive Engineering Lead:** Antigravity (Google DeepMind)  
**Implementation Engine:** Claude Code CLI  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Modernize the complete Super Admin Console and platform control operations in React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS v4 with Cuba M3 executive glassmorphic styling, ensuring 100% functional parity with legacy implementations in `src/components/admin/`:

1. **Twenty-Four Sub-Modules Parity (NO 7-TAB TRUNCATION SHORTCUT)**:
   - **CRITICAL ANTI-TRUNCATION INVARIANT**: The developer MUST NOT reduce the admin console to 7 generic tabs. All 24 sub-directories in `src/components/admin/` must be preserved:
     1. **`health`**: System Health, Apache server status, MariaDB connection pool, and Node.js process telemetry.
     2. **`dashboard`**: Global analytics, MRR, active users, candidate registrations, and conversion metrics.
     3. **`usersManager`**: User 360 directory, user search, filtering, account suspension, and account deletion.
     4. **`userEdit`**: User profile editor, password resets, role assignment (Admin, Recruiter, Candidate), and quota overrides.
     5. **`operators`**: Super Admin operator accounts, session management, and operator audit trail.
     6. **`employerApplications`**: Employer account verification, company registration documents review, and approval/rejection workflows.
     7. **`companyManagement`**: Verified company badges, domain verification claims, and company directory.
     8. **`jobsManager`**: Global job postings moderation, editing, spam flagging, and feature status toggles.
     9. **`settings` (AI Provider Orchestration)**: Multi-provider orchestration (NVIDIA NIM, Gemini, Groq, custom model IDs), API key configuration, and post-save secret masking.
     10. **AI Benchmarks**: Live model latency, token throughput, error rate telemetry, and circuit breaker status.
     11. **`queues`**: Background job queue monitor (emails, AI synthesis, PDF exports) and dead-letter queue retries.
     12. **Durable Outbox Monitor**: Outbox event processor telemetry, failure counters, and manual event resending.
     13. **`phrases`**: ATS phrase dictionary, industry keywords, and prohibited scam terms.
     14. **`HelpDesk`**: Customer support ticket resolution desk, ticket assignment, and email replies.
     15. **`audit`**: Platform security audit logs, IP logs, auth attempts, and exportable event trails.
     16. **`attention`**: Critical system incidents, failed webhooks, and operational alert banners.
     17. **`operations`**: Database backup triggers, cache invalidation, and dual-database sync status.
     18. **`tenants`**: Enterprise tenant organizations list, tier overrides, and custom quota limits.
     19. **`messages`**: Platform-wide broadcast notifications and banner announcements.
     20. **`landingPages`**: Dynamic landing page builder, hero CTA configuration, and marketing banners.
     21. **`blogManagement`**: CMS articles directory, categories, tags, and comment moderation.
     22. **`reviews`**: Candidate and employer testimonials moderation and Trustpilot badges.
     23. **`TrustedBy`**: Enterprise client trust logos management.
     24. **`command`**: Super Admin command palette and operational quick-actions.

2. **In-App CMS Blog & Article Editor (`/blog-editor` & `/blog-editor/:postId`)**:
   - Preserve the full `BlogEditor.jsx` application for authorized authors and admins.
   - Article creation, draft autosaving, markdown/rich-text editor, hero banner upload, category/tag assignment, SEO meta tags, and publication scheduler.

3. **Platform Maintenance Mode Controller**:
   - Global platform maintenance mode toggle stored in MariaDB (`systemHealth.maintenanceMode`).
   - Custom maintenance message and emergency bypass for authenticated administrators.

4. **Payment Gateway & Invoicing Administration**:
   - Live configuration of payment providers (Stripe, Razorpay, Paytm) with write-only secrets handling.
   - Global invoice audit table, refund processing, and subscription reconciler triggers.

5. **Security & Secret Protection Invariants**:
   - Zero plaintext secret leakage in API payloads, DOM, or client state.
   - Post-save masking: clear secret inputs and display only active status badge.
   - Enforce Super Admin authorization guard on every admin route and action.

6. **Final Integrated Regression & Five-Surface Verification**:
   - Full cross-surface regression verification.
   - Complete Playwright crawl across all 5 modernized surfaces with zero console errors.
   - Final Gatekeeper independent audit and release freeze.

---

### 2. Invariants
- ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS: All 24 sub-modules, Blog Editor, and Maintenance Controller preserved.
- ZERO PLAINTEXT TOKEN LEAKAGE: Server-only secret storage.
- WCAG 2.1 AA ACCESSIBILITY & Sub-4s build.
invariants: ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS: Full preservation of all 24 Admin sub-modules from src/components/admin/ (no 7-tab truncation shortcut).

ADMIN API CONTRACTS: Platform health and telemetry MUST bind to GET /api/platform/operational-status (full 28-service matrix) and GET /api/platform/public-config (banning phantom /api/admin/stats). AI provider orchestration MUST bind to GET /api/admin/ai-settings, POST /api/admin/ai/test-provider, and GET /api/admin/ai/models/:provider (banning phantom /api/admin/ai-providers). Support ticket administration MUST bind to GET /api/admin/support/tickets, messages via POST /api/admin/support/tickets/:ticketId/messages (banning phantom /reply), and updates via PATCH /api/admin/support/tickets/:ticketId.

ADMIN EMAIL & DELIVERABILITY CONTRACT: Email configuration, deliverability metrics, and test connections MUST bind to /api/email/admin/* (GET /api/email/admin/settings, GET /api/email/admin/deliverability, POST /api/email/admin/test-connection, POST /api/email/admin/save-smtp). Calling /api/admin/email/* returns HTTP 404.
ZERO PLAINTEXT SECRET LEAKAGE: Never expose provider API keys in client state or DOM.
SUPER_ADMIN_AUTHORIZATION: Server-side authorization verification for all admin routes.
WCAG 2.1 AA ACCESSIBILITY: Full keyboard navigation and color contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin console renders within CubaAppShell with system telemetry and module navigation.
Platform health binds to GET /api/platform/operational-status and displays real 28-subsystem metrics.
AI Provider Orchestration binds to GET /api/admin/ai-settings, test endpoint /api/admin/ai/test-provider, with post-save secret masking.
Support ticket desk binds to GET /api/admin/support/tickets and staff messages bind to POST /api/admin/support/tickets/:ticketId/messages.
Admin email and deliverability controls bind to /api/email/admin/* endpoints without 404 routing errors.
All 24 sub-modules verified: health telemetry, user 360, moderation, queues, and dictionary.
In-App Blog Editor (/blog-editor) verified with article creation, editing, and publishing.
Platform maintenance mode toggle verified with public block and admin bypass.
User suspension and impersonation verified with audit trail generation.
Secret scanner confirms zero plaintext API keys in frontend build or DOM.
Full five-surface Playwright crawl passes with zero console errors.
TypeScript check passes with zero errors (tsc -b).
